camel_example: aliyun sts AssumeRoleWithSAML --region cn-hangzhou --Policy url_encoded_policy --SAMLAssertion base64_encoded_saml_assertion --DurationSeconds 3600 --SAMLProviderArn 'acs:ram::1234567890120000:saml-provider/company1' --RoleArn 'acs:ram::1234567890120000:role/adminrole'
description_en: For role-based single sign-on (SSO) that uses Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), call the AssumeRoleWithSAML operation to obtain a temporary identity credential (a Security Token Service (STS) token) for a RAM role
description_zh: 进行SAML角色SSO时，通过调用AssumeRoleWithSAML接口，获取扮演RAM角色的临时身份凭证（STS Token）
kebab_example: aliyun sts assume-role-with-saml --saml-provider-arn acs:ram::1234567890120000:saml-provider/company1 --role-arn acs:ram::1234567890120000:role/adminrole --saml-assertion base64_encoded_saml_assertion --policy url_encoded_policy --duration-seconds 3600 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssumeRoleWithSAML

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the SAML IdP that is created in RAM.

Format: `acs:ram::<account_id>:saml-provider/<saml_provider_name>`.

You can view the ARN of the IdP in the RAM console or by calling an API operation:

RAM console: For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116795.html.

API: For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186833.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186851.html
parameters.help_zh:
RAM中创建的SAML身份提供商的ARN。

格式：`acs:ram::<account_id>:saml-provider/<saml_provider_id>`。

您可以通过RAM控制台或API查看身份提供商的ARN。具体如下：

RAM控制台：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116795.html。
API：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186833.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186851.html
parameters.name: saml_provider_arn

parameters.help_en:
The ARN of the RAM role to assume.

The trusted entity of the RAM role is a SAML IdP. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116805.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html.

Format: `acs:ram::<account_id>:role/<role_name>`.

You can view the ARN of the role in the RAM console or by calling an API operation:

RAM console: For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39744.html.

API: For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.help_zh:
要扮演的RAM角色的ARN。

该角色是可信实体为SAML身份提供商的RAM角色。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116805.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html。

格式：`acs:ram::<account_id>:role/<role_name>`。

您可以通过RAM控制台或API查看角色ARN。具体如下：

RAM控制台：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/39744.html。
API：请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28713.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28711.html
parameters.name: role_arn

parameters.help_en:
The Base64-encoded SAML assertion.

The value must be 4 to 100,000 characters in length.

Obtain the complete SAML response from the IdP. Do not use only the SAML assertion field
parameters.help_zh:
Base64编码后的SAML断言。

长度为4~100000个字符。

需要从IdP获取完整的SAML响应，不能是单独的SAML断言字段
parameters.name: saml_assertion

parameters.help_en:
An access policy to further limit the permissions of the STS token. This parameter works as follows:

If you specify this policy, the permissions of the STS token are the intersection of the permissions that are granted to the RAM role and the permissions that are specified in this policy.

If you do not specify this policy, the STS token has all the permissions that are granted to the RAM role.

The value must be 1 to 2,048 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
为STS Token额外添加的一个权限策略，进一步限制STS Token的权限。具体如下：

如果指定该权限策略，则STS Token最终的权限取RAM角色权限策略与该权限策略的交集。
如果不指定该权限策略，则STS Token最终的权限就是RAM角色的权限。

长度为1~2048个字符
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
The expiration duration of the token. Unit: seconds.

The minimum value is 900 seconds. The maximum value is the value of the `MaxSessionDuration` parameter. The default value is 3600 seconds.

You can set the `MaxSessionDuration` parameter when you call the CreateRole or UpdateRole operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28712.html
parameters.help_zh:
Token有效期。单位：秒。

Token有效期最小值为900秒，最大值为`MaxSessionDuration`设置的时间，默认值为3600秒。

您可以通过CreateRole或UpdateRole接口设置角色最大会话时间`MaxSessionDuration`。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28710.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28712.html
parameters.name: duration_seconds

AssumedRoleUser.description_en: The temporary identity of the assumed role

Arn.description_en: The ARN of the temporary identity

AssumedRoleId.description_en: The ID of the temporary identity

Expiration.description_en: The expiration time of the token. The time is in UTC

SecurityToken.description_en:
The security token.

The security token has a variable length. Do not impose a maximum length limit on the security token
SecurityToken.description_zh:
安全令牌。
安全令牌的长度不固定，我们强烈建议您不要对安全令牌的最大长度做任何限制

SAMLAssertionInfo.description_en: The information about the SAML assertion

Issuer.description_en: The value of the `Issuer` field in the SAML assertion

Recipient.description_en: The value of the `Recipient` attribute in the `Subject - SubjectConfirmation - SubjectConfirmationData` field of the SAML assertion
Recipient.description_zh: SAML断言中`Subject - SubjectConfirmation - SubjectConfirmationData`字段中`Recipient`属性的值

Subject.description_en: The value of the `Subject - NameID` field in the SAML assertion

SubjectType.description_en: The format of the NameID element in the SAML assertion. If the prefix is `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:`, the prefix is removed. Examples: `persistent` and `transient`
SubjectType.description_zh: SAML断言中`NameID`的格式。当前缀为`urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:`时，前缀会被移除。例如：`persistent/transient`

SourceIdentity.description_en:
The source identity.

When you assume a role, you can specify a source identity for the role user. The source identity is used as the initial identity of the session. The value of the source identity persists throughout chained role-assuming sessions and cannot be changed. This ensures the traceability and security of operations.

This parameter is not returned if you do not set a source identity
SourceIdentity.description_zh:
源身份信息。

在扮演角色时，可以指定扮演者的源身份（SourceIdentity）作为会话的初始身份标识。 该源身份的值在持续扮演角色的链式会话中将一直存在，中途不可更改，可确保操作的可追溯性和安全性。

如果没有设置源身份信息，则该字段不会返回
